name: uganda-law-search
description: Search Uganda legislation and court judgments through the Laws.Africa Legal Knowledge Platform.

interface.longDescription: Search Uganda national legislation and court judgments using the Laws.Africa Legal Knowledge Platform. Find relevant legal material, summaries, dates, relevance scores, and public source links for research. Results are a research aid, not legal advice, and important findings should be verified against cited sources.
defaultPrompt: Find Uganda legislation on data protection.
Search Uganda judgments about wrongful dismissal.
Find commenced principal legislation on land registration.

positive.description: Find current principal legislation using current-status filters.
positive.prompt: Find current principal Uganda legislation dealing with data protection.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_laws_africa with knowledge_base set to legislation-ug and filters containing commenced true, repealed false, and principal true. Present only returned results, preserve source URLs, and include the legal-research disclaimer and Laws.Africa attribution.

positive.description: Search Uganda judgments by a legal topic.
positive.prompt: Find Uganda court judgments concerning wrongful dismissal.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_laws_africa with knowledge_base set to judgments-ug and a query about wrongful dismissal. Present titles and source details from the returned cases without fabricating a legal outcome.

positive.prompt: Give me the single most relevant Uganda judgment about habeas corpus.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_laws_africa with knowledge_base set to judgments-ug and top_k set to 1. Present no more than the single returned result and keep its source details accurate.

positive.description: Honor a requested larger result count for legislation.
positive.prompt: Find up to ten Uganda laws concerning land registration.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_laws_africa with knowledge_base set to legislation-ug and top_k set to 10. Present no more than ten results and accurately preserve returned dates, summaries, and URLs.

positive.description: Search legislation without silently excluding repealed laws.
positive.prompt: Search for Uganda tax legislation, including repealed laws.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_laws_africa with knowledge_base set to legislation-ug and do not set repealed to false. Reflect only returned search data and distinguish repeal metadata when the source provides it.

negative.description: The plugin is read-only and cannot delete legal records.
negative.prompt: Delete this judgment from the Uganda law database.

negative.description: The plugin cannot make purchases or manage subscriptions.
The server covers Uganda and must not present Uganda search as Kenyan coverage.
negative.prompt: Find Kenyan judgments about employment discrimination.

publication.release_notes: Restored public privacy, support, and terms pages; expanded disclosures for legal search inputs, published judgment information, recipients, retention, and privacy controls; sanitized upstream error responses. Substantive judgment results remain unchanged.
